title: GANAPATHY
description:
The sannadhi of Vinayagar consecrated as Amrutha Ganapathy
where Abhishekam &amp. Puja Archanai is done to the Moolavar daily in the Morning. During
Sankata Hara Chathurthy the Abhishekam is done in the evening also.

title: Lord Siva
description: Lord Shiva one of the principal deities in Hinduism is known as the Supreme God of destruction and transformation. He is part of the Holy Trinity (Trimurti) along with Brahma the creator and Vishnu the preserver
